summary_en: 700,000 shares (6.09% of shares outstanding excluding treasury), ¥1,000M upper limit, ¥1,429/share ceiling implied, acquisition window Aug 17 – Dec 31, 2026, ToSTNeT-3 method. Stated rationale: capital policy, shareholder returns, capital efficiency, stable shareholder base.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Pertaining to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 14 August 2026, the board of Dai-ichi Cutter Kogyo resolved to authorize the acquisition of up to 700,000 ordinary shares (6.09% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for up to ¥1,000 million. The acquisition will be conducted via ToSTNeT-3 (off-market electronic trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange) from 17 August through 31 December 2026. The implied maximum price per share is ¥1,428. The company stated that the acquisition is part of its capital policy and aims to enhance shareholder returns, improve capital efficiency, and stabilize its shareholder base. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 501,613 treasury shares and had 11,498,387 shares outstanding (excluding treasury). The filing notes that acquisition may be partial or suspended depending on market conditions.
